title: Clone Graph
statement: Given a reference to a node in an undirected connected graph, return a deep copy of the graph.
Each node has a unique value and a list of neighbor nodes; the copied graph must not reuse any original node.
constraints: Node values are unique and match their 1-indexed position in the adjacency list.
The graph is connected when the input node is not null.
There are no repeated edges and no self-loops.
